layout.body:
Subject: Maintenance Notice
Dear Mr. Brown,
We are pleased that you are considering our facility for your mother’s birthday party.
Our maintenance team is scheduled to paint your apartment’s living room on March 11 starting at 9:00 a.m. We ask that you leave the apartment and not return until one hour after the painters have finished at 12:00 p.m.
Best regards,
Anna Davis

questions.stem: What room in the apartment will be painted?
questions.analysis: What room in the apartment will be painted? 原文依据：Our maintenance team is scheduled to paint your apartment’s living room. 我们的维修团队计划粉刷您公寓的客厅。 A：厨房 → 错误 B：餐厅 → 错误 C：客厅 → 正确 D：卧室 → 错误

questions.stem: When can Mr. Brown return to the apartment?
questions.analysis: When can Mr. Brown return to the apartment? 原文依据：painters have finished at 12:00 p.m. … not return until one hour after the painters have finished. 油漆工在中午 12 点完工…… 请在完工一小时后再回来。 A：上午 9 点 → 错误 B：上午 11 点 → 错误 C：中午 12 点 → 错误 D：下午 1 点 → 正确
